key_claims.claim: Double-level emergency cerclage was directly compared to single-level cerclage plus progesterone in a multicenter RCT, providing the first randomized evidence on technique selection in the emergency setting
Lithium exposure in pregnancy is associated with approximately doubled risk of spontaneous preterm birth and LGA, and roughly 2.6-fold increased risk of congenital cardiac malformations
Ischemic placental disease significantly increases postpartum hospitalization risk for neurological and psychiatric disorders within the delivery year
Individual severe features of preeclampsia carry distinct associations with severe maternal morbidity, suggesting heterogeneous risk profiles
The Hadlock EFW reference chart and its regression equation show systematic discrepancies near the 3rd and 10th centiles that affect SGA classification
